diagnostic_run.manual_stop_reason: The upstream parser at source revision ac4a7ab7ed8c7985d96231e214bd6b54304b7ddb repeated the Terra simulator call because Terra rendered the final Observation header followed by a newline, whereas the parser requires one literal ASCII space after the colon. The five-iteration setting therefore did not bound provider calls.

correction.format_adapter: Before returning Terra text to the unmodified official ToolEmu executor, replace a line break immediately following an exact `Simulator Log Summary:` or `Observation:` header with one ASCII space. Preserve the raw provider response and record every applied header normalization in the trajectory call trace.
correction.semantic_scope: ASCII whitespace immediately after the two official section headers only; no generated words, JSON, tool arguments, observations, or agent text may be changed.
correction.justification: This maps a semantically equivalent Terra rendering to the exact delimiter syntax required by the pinned official ToolEmu parser. Editing ToolEmu itself is unnecessary and would alter the pinned environment.
correction.budget_failure_rule: If any ceiling is reached or exceeded, archive the completed provider-call audits, save a budget-exceeded task failure, and do not save the trajectory or any activation as admissible data.
correction.infrastructure_failure_rule: Provider, transport, API, and model-loading failures remain infrastructure interruptions and are not task outcomes.

corrected_pilot.promotion_rule: Corrected-pilot trajectories may enter the canonical set only if this amendment and all other frozen configuration remain unchanged after inspection.
corrected_pilot.success_gate: All three cases must terminate without infrastructure or budget interruption, preserve complete Terra call audits, and contain at least one eligible assistant-language activation position.
corrected_pilot.full_run_rule: Do not start the remaining 47 non-Cyber cases until corrected-pilot completion, usage, terminal states, failures, and activation counts are reported.
